bestBets.overview: At the time of writing (Thursday) the track is rated a soft 5 but with fine weather forecast an upgrade is expected. PAC FAIR got back and found the line nicely as fave at his heavy track debut. He's been given time to mature and has been close up in both lead-in trials. Keep him very safe again. RADOMIR battled rising in grade third up but this is easier and his first two runs this prep were sound. TED LASSO drops in trip but is yet to run a bad race. The debutante SYRINX is nicely bred and has placed in both trials.

raceTips.comment: Gold Coast racing on Saturday, track rated a Good (4) this morning, showers are possible. Ted Lasso is on the quick back up after running home strongly at the Sunshine Coast last Sunday. That was 1600m this is 1400m which isn't ideal however he had little luck there & does look very close to breaking through, I'll stick. Back in grade Radomir can improve sharply whilst Pac Fair a market watch resuming, the 1400m is the complete unknown.
